patch.summary:
Choose Dialpad only if your buying job matches “AI-first cloud phone (Dialpad Connect) with included transcription/summaries — Standard fr” rather than respond.io's shape. Choose respond.io only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel customer messaging platform (WhatsApp + other channels) with shared inbox and ” rather than Dialpad's shape. Workflow advantage: Dialpad leans business-phone, sales-calling; respond.io leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Dialpad is AI-first cloud phone (Dialpad Connect) with included transcription/summaries — Standard from $15/user/month annual; Sell and Support are sep; respond.io is Omnichannel customer messaging platform (WhatsApp + other channels) with shared inbox and AI — Starter from $79/month annual-equivalent..
- Workflow coverage skew: Dialpad-leaning business-phone, sales-calling, team-communication vs respond.io-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support.
- Researched limits: Dialpad — Pricing page is product-tab heavy — Connect vs Support vs Sell can confuse buyers comparing a single seat price; respond.io — Not a business phone system — no IVR, queues or PSTN calling product.
